newsitem.title: CANADA: Explosion injures eight people in Quebec.
newsitem.headline: Explosion injures eight people in Quebec.

text.p: Nine people were injured in an explosion in a Quebec furniture factory on Tuesday, police said.

"Thirty workers were in the factory at the time of the explosion. We think that the explosion might be related to the presence of chemicals and solvents used to polish the furniture," Quebec provincial police officer Daniel Lamirand said.
Eight victims were taken to a hospital, with five seriously burned in the fire, authorities said.
The fire also destroyed two houses near the factory, which is in a residential area of St.Gregoire, a village halfway between Quebec City and Montreal.
